title: Record rains in Kantō and Tōhoku cause flooding, landslides, and paralyze transport
summary: Extreme precipitation triggered maximum alerts, forced the evacuation of thousands, and suspended train and road services in the Tokyo region and northeastern Japan.

title: Far-right AfD wins regional elections in eastern Germany and becomes leading force
summary: Alternative for Germany achieves historic victory in Thuringia and Saxony, while the ruling CDU suffers a heavy defeat.

title: Tokyo bans tourist rentals in residential and school zones of Shinjuku, the district with the most 'minpaku'
summary: The regulation affects more than half of existing accommodations, and Ōta considers similar measures to curb neighborhood problems.

title: Fire at a pastry shop in Gifu leaves three dead; body of a man with stab wounds found in a car
summary: The blaze, coinciding with the shop's 20th anniversary, causes shock; police investigate the causes and possible criminal involvement.

title: U.S. envoy visits Kyiv for first time to explore diplomatic avenues with Russia and Ukraine
summary: The mission aims to revive tripartite dialogue, though major disagreements persist over conditions for a potential ceasefire.

title: Tohoku Shinkansen resumes service after temporary suspension due to a personal accident
summary: The line between Tokyo and Sendai was halted for nearly two hours; no injuries among passengers.

title: Former Johnny's employee admits sexual abuse of eight minors at the agency
summary: A former staff member testified that Johnny's office committed abuses against about eight young talents, amid the company's restructuring process.

title: Amazon cargo plane runs off runway in Miami, causing five deaths
summary: The aircraft crashed while landing at the international airport; authorities investigate the accident.

title: Japan's foreign reserves fall 6.2% in August, the largest monthly drop, due to intervention to curb the yen
summary: The Ministry of Finance confirms that dollar sales to support the national currency reduced reserves to $1.25 trillion.

title: Tokyo Stock Exchange extends gains driven by U.S. semiconductors; yen strengthens amid uncertainty over U.S. interest rates
summary: The Nikkei surpasses 36,000 points as investors assess the possibility that the Fed will keep rates high for longer.

title: Pitcher Ogasawara earns first complete game with Giants as team secures decisive victory
summary: After a reliever marathon the previous day, Ogasawara shuts out the opponent and timely hitting secures Yomiuri's win.
